lead.title: FCC Approves New Rules for Drone Communications and Detection
lead.summary: The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) voted November 19 to adopt new rules expanding spectrum access for drone communications, detection systems, and aviation broadband. The unanimous decision addresses the 450 MHz band for aviation communications, the 24 GHz band for drone detection, and the 800 MHz air-ground band for broadband services.

The California Department of Motor Vehicles barred Waymo driverless taxis from driving on state highways, determining that the operations pose a direct threat to public safety.

leads.title: FCC expands connectivity for UAS operations in the United States
leads.summary: The FCC introduced rules opening the 450 MHz band for safety-related data links and permitting drones to use broadband connectivity from non-geostationary satellites in the 28.35-28.6 GHz band. The commission also allowed ground-based radar systems to use the 24.45–24.65 GHz band to detect and track unauthorised or dangerous UAS near airports, borders, prisons, stadiums, and critical infrastructure.

stories.title: Beyond the demo: How Guangdong's Topstar is bringing humanoid robots closer to the factory floor
stories.summary: Guangdong-based robotics company Topstar unveiled Star, a 172-centimeter-tall, 72-kilogram bipedal robot with a 10-kilogram payload capacity, at its TOPS DAY 2026 event in Dongguan. The robot is designed for material handling and sorting tasks as part of a push to bring embodied AI into manufacturing.

stories.title: Telecoms: Spain gets ready to test FRMCS in the field
stories.summary: Infrastructure manager ADIF called tenders for the renewal, operation, and maintenance of the GSM-R telecommunications network on Spain's high-speed lines, along with related energy systems.

stories.title: Dubai targets Q2 2027 commercial air taxi launch between Dubai Marina and Dubai International Airport Vertiport, with trials starting soon
stories.summary: Khaled Al Awadhi, director of the Roads and Transport Authority's Transportation Systems Department, said trials for an electric air taxi service are due to start next month, with commercial passenger launch most probably coming in Q2 2027. The service will initially link Dubai Marina and the Dubai International Airport Vertiport using two electric air taxis.

also.title: In Dubai, it will be possible to reach the airport by air taxi in 10 minutes
Dubai Marina Air Taxi Station Certified for Dubai Airport Route

stories.title: MARTA finishes 450-gate upgrade at all rail stations
stories.summary: MARTA activated 450 new tap-to-pay fare gates across all 38 rail stations, culminating at Dunwoody Station Friday afternoon. The agency also announced portable fare validators, magnetic emergency exit locks, and pending state safety certification for its new CQ400 trains.

stories.title: Freight train derailment suspends Gyeongbu Line services between Cheonan and Daejeon
stories.summary: Freight train No. 3810 derailed at Sojeong-ri Station in Sejong on Saturday, suspending regular train services on the Gyeongbu Line between Cheonan and Daejeon. Five of the train's 21 cars came off the tracks, severing overhead power lines and cutting electricity to the section between Cheonan and Jeonui.

also.title: Freight train derails near Sejong, leaving Saemaeul, Mugunghwa services suspended

stories.title: Self-Driving Cybersecurity Needs New Thinking: 2 UN Rules
stories.summary: A Mobility Engineering article argues that traditional vehicle threat models fail to capture the cybersecurity risks of autonomous driving stacks, which blend machine-learning models, middleware, and safety mechanisms. The piece recommends that security assessments examine source code, runtime behavior, and safety-critical data flows, prioritizing localization, planning, and vehicle control to prevent tampered data from altering vehicle behavior.

also.title: Self-Driving Vehicles Demand New Cybersecurity Thinking

stories.title: Russia Plans to Shift Airline Subsidies Toward Flights Bypassing Moscow as Drone Restrictions Disrupt Airports
stories.summary: Russia's Transportation Ministry intends to redirect airline subsidies to expand direct flights between regions, as drone threats repeatedly force Moscow's airports to suspend operations. Transportation Minister Dmitry Yadrov said Thursday at the Transport of Russia forum that the ministry would work with the federal aviation agency Rosaviatsia to revise how the subsidies are allocated.

stories.title: Putnam Sheriff Shares Drone Safeguards
stories.summary: Putnam Sheriff Brian Hess unveiled updated privacy safeguards on Wednesday (Nov. 18) as his department prepares to launch a new drone program for police, fire and medical emergencies. The Sheriff’s Office plans in April to join the Dutchess County Sheriff’s Office and more than 90 other agencies in New York with Drone as First Responder programs.

stories.title: Robots patrol parks, serve meals in Seoul's wealthy Gangnam District
stories.summary: Gangnam District is deploying AI-powered robots across five civic roles, including park patrols and meal service, under a trial running through December 2026 to April 2027. The program provides up to 30 million won ($21,500) to five selected startups to test machines in real-world settings.

stories.title: Drone And License Plate Readers Track Armed Carjackers To Bensalem: Three Arrested After Gunpoint Robbery
stories.summary: Bensalem police arrested three suspects after a drone spotted them walking away from a stolen SUV near the Mt Vernon Circle townhome development. The vehicle was initially located by a license plate reader near Bensalem Boulevard and Bristol Pike following a carjacking at an ACME store in Philadelphia.

stories.title: Tesla’s Robotaxi Guides Now List Roads Posted at Up to 85 MPH
stories.summary: Tesla’s updated Robotaxi guides state Cybercab and Model Y are designed for roads posted at up to 85 mph. The documents confirm two Cybercab hardware changes: a Starlink terminal in the trunk lid and a camera facing into the trunk.

stories.title: Waymo Robotaxi Service Paused Amid Bay Area Storm
stories.summary: Waymo temporarily halted its robotaxi service in the Bay Area on November 18, 2026, after five vehicles stalled on flooded roads in San Francisco. Service reportedly resumed the next day, November 19, 2026.

also.title: Waymo robotaxi pause during San Francisco storm

stories.title: Northrop Grumman Puts AiON Counter-UAS Alerts on a Smartwatch
stories.summary: Northrop Grumman integrated its AiON counter-UAS system with commercially available smartwatches, enabling operational squadrons at the PDBL to monitor drone threats via a compass bezel that indicates direction. The 319th Reconnaissance Wing opened the lab’s permanent facility on April 9, 2026, and any Department of Defense organization can now award a follow-on production transaction for AiON without further competition.

stories.title: Dominion Dynamics taps Canadian and NATO partners for autonomous wingman project
Russia Cuts Military Vehicle Losses by 50% With Anti-Drone Corridors
stories.summary: Lieutenant General Vladimir Konovalov reported that Russian forces built over 2,000 kilometers of anti-drone corridors since the beginning of 2026, cutting military vehicle losses by 50%. He also stated that unmanned ground vehicles transported more than 25,000 tonnes of cargo, a 2.1-fold increase.

stories.title: ACT Expo 2027 to spotlight TCO, autonomous trucks
stories.summary: ACT Expo 2027 will emphasize total cost of ownership for diesel and alternative-fuel trucks and autonomous vehicles during its May 17-20 run in Las Vegas. The event will feature more than 400 exhibitors and sponsors and over 200 commercial vehicles, with workshops addressing vehicle economics, operational risk, and diesel, battery-electric, and hydrogen technologies.

stories.title: This counter-UAS system senses deep inside neighboring borders to detect and defeat drones
Maneuver Battle Lab assesses “drone-defeating” shotgun rounds
stories.summary: The Maneuver Battle Lab conducted a live-fire assessment Sept. 21-22, 2026, at Fort Benning, Ga., testing four shotgun rounds against small unmanned aircraft systems. The lab will submit findings to the Maneuver Future Capability Directorate and Product Manager for Small Caliber Ammunition before the end of 2026 to determine if the Army should adopt commercial or government-standard counter-drone solutions.

stories.title: Watco expands Intramotev autonomous railcar operations to Texas
stories.summary: Watco will deploy Intramotev’s TugVolt autonomous railcars at a second site in Seadrift, Texas, following successful operations in Wood River, Illinois. The new agreement expands the use of the technology, which has moved more than 650,000 tons of material, to switch railcars within an industrial facility.

stories.title: Tesla Cybercab involved in Austin crash — who’s at fault?
stories.summary: A Tesla Cybercab and a truck collided Thursday morning in Austin, Texas, the same day Tesla expanded Cybercab rides to Dallas. Witness accounts blame the Cybercab, but the article argues the human truck driver was at fault for turning from the wrong lane.

also.title: Tesla Cybercab robotaxi expands to Dallas after Austin
Zero To Sixty: Tesla Expands Cybercab To Dallas As Waymo Pauses Freeway Operations This Week

stories.title: Waymo recalls self-driving cars over closed freeway lanes, manual traffic control
stories.summary: Alphabet's self-driving unit Waymo filed two safety recalls with the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration on Thursday to improve how its robotaxis navigate closed freeway lanes and intersections with manual traffic control. The recalls follow a California Department of Motor Vehicles ban on Waymo vehicles from freeways, which took effect last week after incidents involving active construction zones.

also.title: Waymo announces two robotaxi recalls as closed-lane software fix remains unfinished
Waymo Robotaxis Face 2 Recalls Over Closed Freeway Lane Violations, Traffic Control Issues

stories.title: 20 senators ask Amtrak to rethink guns inside passenger cars
stories.summary: Twenty U.S. senators urged Amtrak to reconsider a planned January 2027 policy allowing unloaded guns in carry-on baggage inside passenger cars. The November 19 letter, led by Senator Kirsten Gillibrand, gives Amtrak until December 9, 2026, to answer 15 questions about the change, which would affect routes carrying 87.1% of fiscal year 2025 trips.

stories.title: VIDEO: Britain Is Bringing Ukraine's Magura Sea Drones to the Atlantic
stories.summary: Britain’s defense secretary remotely controlled UFORCE’s MV7 sea drone from HMS Prince of Wales in Norway while the vessel operated off Portugal. The British-built successor to Ukraine’s Magura family received £113 million in new investment and is designed for Atlantic conditions.

stories.title: DHL Supply Chain and the End of Peak Season: Can Warehouse Robotics Flex Fast Enough?
stories.summary: DHL Supply Chain operates more than 9,000 collaborative robots globally and can temporarily expand its active robot fleet by approximately 30 percent during peak periods. The company states its robotic systems have supported more than 1.5 billion item picks.

stories.title: Mysterious MQ-25 Stingray-Like Chinese Drone Emerges At Little-Known Flight Test Center
stories.summary: Satellite imagery revealed an uncrewed aircraft at Pucheng Neifu Airport in Shaanxi Province, China, with a wingspan of approximately 66 feet and a length of 49 feet. The drone bears strong similarities to Boeing’s MQ-25 Stingray, though it features a tapered nose and a dorsal intake, and its manufacturer remains unidentified.

stories.title: Rockwell Automation Raises Margin Target, Bets on Robots and AI at Investor Day
stories.summary: Rockwell Automation raised its long-term enterprise operating margin target to a midpoint of 25% and agreed to acquire European autonomous mobile robot maker AGILOX at its annual investor day. The company also introduced FactoryTalk Conductor, an industrial agent platform designed to coordinate people, AI agents, and production systems across design, operation, and maintenance workflows.

stories.title: SharkSmart drone program changes down to trial results
stories.summary: Oceans for All renewed its call for the Queensland Shark Smart drone program to expand to seven days a week and full-day operations after the Noosa Triathlon swim leg was cancelled due to shark activity. A Department of Primary Industries spokesperson stated the department will not consider changes to operating arrangements until the outcome of advanced technology trials is known.

stories.title: Meteomatics’ Drones Close Weather Blind Spot for Southern Power Markets
stories.summary: Meteomatics opened a new Meteobase at McAlester Regional Airport, the first active U.S. airport to host an operational weather drone base. The site extends coverage into the Southwest Power Pool, following an eight-month pilot in Purcell, Oklahoma, where the company completed more than 550 flights for the National Weather Service.

stories.title: Garuda Aerospace Showcases Indigenous Defence Drone Capabilities at HADR Exercise 2026
Future Army aviators explore autonomous systems concepts
stories.summary: Army aviation students at Fort Rucker, Ala., participated in a virtual reality demonstration on Nov. 20 to examine how autonomous systems may integrate into future operations. Anduril Industries supported the event, which introduced concepts for human-machine teaming and multi-domain operations without representing an Army procurement or fielding decision.

also.title: Anduril Industries supports U.S. Army virtual reality demonstration of autonomous aviation and battlefield

stories.title: Zipline Asks FAA for 130,000 Drone Deliveries a Day Over Arizona
German-Ukrainian Quantum Frontline Industries to Increase Drone Production Fivefold
stories.summary: Quantum Frontline Industries plans to increase drone production capacity fivefold in 2027, investing over 10 million euros with partners Quantum Systems and Frontline Robotics. The joint venture began producing Linza 3.0 drones in Germany in February 2026 and is completing a contract to supply 10,000 systems to Ukraine.

also.title: Ukrainian drone engineering meets German manufacturing as QFI ramps up production
Quantum Systems Expands Industrial Commitment to Ukraine as Joint Venture Scales Drone Production

stories.title: SkyeBrowse adds photorealism to drone 3D models, speeds up processing 3X
stories.summary: SkyeBrowse announced Realistic 3D, a platform update that adds photorealism to 3D models and claims 3X faster processing. The feature blends original video frames onto models to preserve lighting and shadows, with photorealism available at no additional cost through December 31, 2026.

stories.title: Nearly 500 entries later, DJI names its World Heritage 3D winners
stories.summary: DJI announced the winners of its first World Heritage 3D Conservation Initiative at an award ceremony in Segovia, Spain. The competition received nearly 500 submissions from 32 countries, with four projects receiving Excellence Awards and eight earning People's Choice Awards.

stories.title: Archer Aviation Tumbles 8%, Breaks Below $3 as Air Taxi Rout Rolls On; EHang Slides 6%, Joby Aviation Drops 3%
stories.summary: Archer Aviation shares fell 8% to $2.95, breaking below $3, while EHang Holdings dropped 6% and Joby Aviation declined 3% in afternoon trading. Archer reported Q3 2026 revenue of $5.10 million and a net loss of $274.6 million, ending the quarter with $785.1 million in cash and equivalents.

stories.title: Moldova reports second drone incursion into its airspace in one day
stories.summary: Moldova's Air Operations Center recorded two unauthorized drone incursions into its airspace on November 20, with the second entering from Ukraine's Odesa region at 14:48. The Ministry of Defense reported the first incident occurred overnight at 1:19, crossing from Ukraine's Vinnytsia region.

also.title: Another drone flies unauthorized over airspace of Moldova

stories.title: Air to inaugurate new Florida eVTOL assembly site
Robot Videos: Morphing Robots, Dancing Humanoids, More
stories.summary: IEEE Spectrum published a weekly selection of robotics videos featuring a drone that squeezes into smaller sizes and a robot goose. The collection also includes a Carnegie Mellon University seminar by Ben Burchfiel, Co-Founder & CTO at Walden Robotics, on building physical AI.

stories.title: DJI Asks Court to Force FCC Ruling, BRINC on iPhone, SkyeBrowse 3D
stories.summary: DJI filed a mandamus petition with the Ninth Circuit on November 2nd to force the FCC to act on its January 21st petition. The FCC and Department of Justice answered on November 9th, arguing that DJI needs a final order from the full Commission before the court can step in.

stories.title: Elysian Aircraft Closes €12M Pre-Series A Round and Joins Dutch Military Unmanned Aircraft Program
stories.summary: Elysian Aircraft closed a €12 million pre-Series A round on November 19, 2026, to develop aerospace electrification technologies. The company will lead a project with the NLR to develop unmanned air systems for the Royal Netherlands Air and Space Force.

stories.title: Vertus Analysis: Joby Has Longest Cash Runway at About 11 Quarters, Eve the Smallest Reserve Among Four eVTOL Developers
stories.summary: A Vertus analysis found Joby Aviation holds the largest cash reserve at $2.2 billion, providing about 11 quarters of runway, the longest of four eVTOL developers. BETA Technologies has $1.34 billion in cash for roughly 10 quarters, while Archer Aviation has $1.35 billion for roughly seven quarters.

stories.title: Tesla Cybercab — Anything You Want It to Be
stories.summary: Tesla posted a Robotaxi film on 20 November 2026, a day after the Cybercab arrived in Dallas. The video imagines the two-seat robotaxi taking on different everyday roles.

stories.title: Waymo Targets 2027 Detroit Robotaxi Launch
stories.summary: Waymo confirmed plans to launch public robotaxi rides in Detroit in 2027, setting up a potential rivalry with Tesla, which has already begun testing its Cybercab in the city.

stories.title: German attack drones pass live-fire tests, with first deliveries planned this year
stories.summary: Germany's military procurement office announced that Stark's Virtus and Helsing's HX-2 drones passed live-fire trials this month, clearing a step toward initial deliveries and troop training before the end of the year. The German Army plans to begin equipping its armored brigade in Lithuania in 2027.

stories.title: Galileo Robotics Deploys Quadruped Robot for Warehouse Inspections in Poland
stories.summary: Galileo Robotics deployed its C1-W quadruped robot at a logistics park in Poznan, Poland, to automate warehouse inspections and security patrols. The facility moved from two manual patrol shifts a day to robotic patrols every three hours, with response times to detected problems falling from hours to minutes.

stories.title: XPeng sets 2027 to test its IRON robot in stores and sell it to third parties
stories.summary: XPeng has finalised the deployment schedule for its IRON humanoid robot, with testing in selected stores set for the first quarter of 2027 and external commercialisation in the second quarter of that same year.

stories.title: Auterion and SkyFall Plan German Drone Factory to Supply Ukraine
stories.summary: Auterion and SkyFall announced plans on November 20, 2026, to establish a joint venture in Germany to produce drones for Ukrainian forces. The new factory, called Skyfall x Auterion, will initially manufacture Shrike first-person-view strike drones, with potential future supply to Germany’s military.

Drones for Armed Forces of Ukraine, and Later for Bundeswehr: SkyFall and Auterion to Open Plant in Germany

stories.title: Turkey Unveils Electromagnetic Weapon That Can Take Down 51 Drones in Seconds
stories.summary: Turkish defense company ASELSAN reported that its EJDERHA AD system disabled 51 drones within seconds during a recent demonstration. The company stated the system also disabled two wire-controlled drones at approximately 1,000 meters, a capability that bypasses standard radio-frequency jamming limitations.

stories.title: OMRON Robotics Debuts LD-150 and LD-300 Autonomous Mobile Robots
stories.summary: OMRON Robotics launched the LD-150 and LD-300 autonomous mobile robots, which deliver payloads up to 300 kg and navigate aisles as narrow as 1 meter. Available for pre-order in the Americas and Europe, shipments begin in January 2027.

also.title: Alton Teams With AI Robotics Startup XUP to Build Autonomous Robots

stories.title: Nashville Drones Beat Police to 98% of Calls, Then Overtime Ran Low
stories.summary: Metro Nashville police told a Metro Council committee on Tuesday, November 17, that the three Skydio X10 drones they flew from the Madison Precinct roof this summer reached 911 calls in two minutes on average. Deputy Chief Greg Blair said the department’s next step is training more drone pilots.

stories.title: Council approves zoning variance expanding drone delivery service in Katy
stories.summary: Katy’s city council approved a zoning variance on November 9 to allow Zipline International Inc. to install a drone charging station at the West Ten Business Park. Construction on the six charging towers would start in about four to eight weeks after approval of permits and take about an additional eight to ten weeks to complete.

stories.title: As manufacturing labor shortages persist, robots help fill the gap
stories.summary: North American companies ordered 10,989 robots valued at $723.5 million in the third quarter, a 25% increase over the year-ago period, according to the Association for Advancing Automation. Sectors including logistics, agriculture, life sciences, and electronics now account for more than half of these orders as manufacturers seek to offset labor shortages.

stories.title: Genesis AI raises $500M for robots trained with sensor gloves
stories.summary: Genesis AI announced a $500 million Series A round on Nov. 17 at a $3.5 billion valuation, with Nvidia participating. The company plans to expand data collection and deploy its flagship robot, Eno, targeting manufacturing, logistics and laboratories.

stories.title: The Next Phase of Robotics: From Technological Progress to Real-World Impact
stories.summary: Pudu Robotics gathered regional partners in Amsterdam on November 4, 2026, following the October opening of its European headquarters in Neuss, Germany. The company has shipped over 130,000 units across more than 85 countries and regions, deploying machines across 16 industries and over 900 application scenarios.

stories.title: Around the Commercial Drone Industry: Drone Mothership, Georgia Delivery, Oyster Farming
stories.summary: Schiebel demonstrated its 250-pound CAMCOPTER S-100 as a drone mothership in Austria, successfully releasing an inert OSIRIS HSCD-1 High-Speed Camera Drone while maintaining a communications link. Amazon launched its first Prime Air drone delivery service in Georgia on Nov. 15, serving Metro Atlanta customers within a 7.5-mile radius with packages limited to 5 pounds. Jeri’s Seafood and Palacios Marine Agriculture Research released over one million baby oysters in Galveston Bay, Texas, using an XAG drone to seed about five acres of leased beds.

also.title: This Flying Drone Mothership Could Change Counter-Drone Warfare

stories.title: Department for Transport funds 23 rail projects due to finish by March 2027
stories.summary: The Department for Transport is backing 23 projects with £4.8 million through the First of a Kind rail competition. The 23 projects have begun work, and testing is planned over the coming months.

stories.title: Waymo Suspends Commercial Robotaxi Highway Service Nationwide Starting November 11-Internet Info Agency
stories.summary: Alphabet's Waymo fully suspended commercial driverless taxi service on highways across the United States on November 11, with no timeline for resumption. The California Department of Motor Vehicles barred Waymo driverless taxis from driving on state highways, determining that the operations pose a direct threat to public safety.

stories.title: Newsom Signs Robotaxi Rules Into Law
stories.summary: Governor Gavin Newsom signed SB 1246 on September 30, 2026, setting new rules for autonomous vehicle operators in California. The law requires operators to acknowledge emergency geofencing messages within two minutes and to report fleetwide incident and response data to the DMV quarterly.

also.title: California Enacts New Requirements for Autonomous Vehicle Remote Operations and First-Responder Interactions
California sets new rules for robotaxi remote operations

stories.title: A German box that opens in under 30 seconds, throws a drone into the air and catches it again on a deck
stories.summary: CiS delivered the ORKA Dock to an unnamed defense customer on November 17 after it passed acceptance trials at sea. The German hangar launches and catches a drone on a moving deck in under 30 seconds, supporting surveillance and underwater infrastructure protection.

stories.title: Skydagger HUNTER interceptor drone and TOYCA-05 loitering munition hit targets in test firings
stories.summary: Turkish defense company Skydagger announced that its HUNTER interceptor drone and TOYCA-05 loitering munition successfully struck targets during recent test firings. General Manager Mehmet Öztekin stated the company has raised annual production capacity to 150,000–160,000 units, with nine of eleven components locally manufactured.

stories.title: What Does the FAA’s November 13 Nationwide Ground Stop Mean for Uncrewed Aviation?
stories.summary: The FAA ordered a nationwide ground stop on November 13 after telecommunications problems disrupted air traffic control facilities, keeping departing aircraft on the ground for more than four hours. The agency identified excessive network traffic at Amarillo, Texas, and El Dorado, Arkansas, as possible sources, while denying any connection to its new SMART system.

stories.title: Russian drones flew nearly half of Earth's circumference over Kyiv in 3 months, analysis shows
stories.summary: Ukrainian investigative outlet Texty reported that Russian drones flew a combined distance of more than 19,000 kilometers over Kyiv from August to October, nearly half the Earth's circumference. More than 630 drones were detected during this period, twice the number recorded in the same period last year.

stories.title: Video. Robotaxis and delivery drones: China’s autonomous vehicle race
stories.summary: China's robotaxis now operate commercially in Guangzhou and Shenzhen while drones deliver coffee, medicine and defibrillators, as companies race to take autonomous vehicles from test zones to scale.

stories.title: As the Air Force tries to protect its F-35s from drones, former airmen say it highlights the risks for maintenance crews
stories.summary: The Air Force sought input from private contractors to install nets on aircraft sunshades at Shaw and Tyndall Air Force Bases to prevent small drones from penetrating the structures and damaging F-16s and F-35s.

stories.title: Italy gives green light to Tesla self-driving system ahead of EU approval
stories.summary: Italy granted provisional approval to Tesla's Assisted Driving System (TAD), making it the first major European Union country to embrace the technology. Transport Minister Matteo Salvini said the decision followed a thorough technical feasibility assessment and precedes an ongoing EU approval process.

stories.title: US firm unveils Phantom MKII battlefield humanoid robot with bigger payload, tougher build
stories.summary: Foundation Future Industries unveiled its second-generation Phantom MKII humanoid robot and Cortex II AI system, claiming a 200-pound walking payload and weatherproofing for rain, snow, and dust. The San Francisco-based startup aims to begin early production in the San Francisco Bay Area in early 2027.

stories.title: Archer and Disney Imagineering Launch eVTOL Research Collaboration
stories.summary: Archer Aviation and Walt Disney Imagineering R&D began an exploratory research collaboration focused on the future of transportation, unveiling a Marvel Studios-themed aircraft at the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix. The initial phase involves research and exploration, with no specific projects or technologies announced.

also.title: Archer and Disney Imagineering Begin Exploratory Electric Aircraft Research Collaboration
Archer teams with Disney on aviation research, unveils Avengers-themed air taxi
Archer, Disney Imagineering Begin Early Research Partnership

stories.title: Skylark Labs demonstrates humanoid search for explosive hazards
stories.summary: Skylark Labs demonstrated a humanoid robot that uses a standard handheld metal detector to search for explosive hazards under human supervision. The robot swept a designated area and backed off when the detector beeped, completing the sequence without separate commands for each step.

stories.title: US Army Taps Velo3D to Develop 3D-Printed Drone Payloads
stories.summary: Velo3D was selected by the US Army to develop 3D-printed drone payloads through a contract worth up to $10 million. The company will use laser powder bed fusion to manufacture warhead components from Inconel 718 and a second high-performance alloy, while the government retains design authority and testing responsibility.

stories.title: Russia Resumes Limited Passenger Rail Service Across Crimean Bridge
stories.summary: Russian-installed authorities in occupied Crimea restored limited passenger rail service across the Crimean Bridge on Thursday after three days of Ukrainian drone and missile strikes. Trains are running slowly and are crowded, the shipping channel beneath the bridge is largely blocked by wreckage, and storms on Friday halted all ferry traffic, including a new emergency passenger service using river boats.

stories.title: US Army Taps Xtremis to Detect Drones Using Changing Radio Signals
GLOBALFOUNDRIES (GFS) Expands Robot Rollout With First Humanoid Fab Trials Set For 2027
stories.summary: GlobalFoundries plans to expand its robotics partnership with Boston Dynamics by broadening the deployment of Spot robots for inspection and monitoring tasks across its semiconductor fabrication plants worldwide. First on-site trials of Boston Dynamics' Atlas humanoid robot at GlobalFoundries fabs are scheduled to begin in 2027.

stories.title: WITRON Enters Autonomous Warehouse Robotics Market With SOLWR Robotics AS
stories.summary: The WITRON Group acquired Norwegian technology enterprise SOLWR Robotics AS, headquartered in Ålesund. SOLWR Robotics will continue to operate from its existing locations under the leadership of its successful management team.

stories.title: Track trials of India’s indigenous bullet train expected by mid-2027
stories.summary: Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced that track trials for India’s indigenous B28 bullet train are expected by mid-2027, with first service commencing in the last quarter of 2027 on the Surat–Vapi section. The B28 trainset, designed for a top speed of 280 kmph, is being manufactured by Integral Coach Factory and Bharat Earth Movers Limited.

also.title: India's first bullet train service set for 2027, Surat-Vapi section first
Bullet Train Update: India’s First High-Speed Rail Service to Begin in Late 2027

stories.title: US Army tested naval drone that rescued airmen on port security
stories.summary: The Army's DEVCOM Ground Vehicle Systems Center evaluated Saronic Corsair naval drones at military ocean terminals in North Carolina and California earlier this year to test their port security capabilities. The 24-foot-long vessels, which use onboard radars and cameras for 360-degree views, are GPS- and satellite-enabled to maintain operator connections while reducing the burden on crewed boats.

also.source: London School of Business and Research (LSBR)

stories.title: Amazon Jacksonville Drone Pad: Code Says 500 Feet, Request Says 29
stories.summary: Amazon confirmed on November 19 that it is working to start Prime Air drone delivery in Jacksonville, Florida, in the coming months, and the city’s Planning Commission approved a launch pad the same day at 7489 Commonwealth Avenue, a building the Jax Daily Record calls an Amazon fulfillment center, the paper reported. Amazon had not announced the city when DroneXL reported on September 25 that a local pilot had photographed Amazon’s Jacksonville airspace map at an airport meeting.

stories.title: 100 Russian Drones by Day, Up to 200 by Night—Ukraine Endures Near-Constant Air Attacks
stories.summary: Ukrainian Air Force spokesperson Yurii Ihnat said Russian forces are launching more than 100 attack drones during the day and up to 200 overnight, with jet-powered models accounting for as much as 95% of the drones used on certain days.

stories.title: Mumbai-Ahmedabad Bullet Train project moves at full pace, 1st service targeted for late 2027: Vaishnaw
stories.summary: Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said India's first bullet train project between Mumbai and Ahmedabad is moving at full pace, with the first high-speed rail service targeted to begin operations in the last quarter of 2027. The 508-km corridor is designed for speeds of up to 350 kmph, with trains expected to operate at 320 kmph, reducing travel time to less than two hours.

also.title: India's first bullet train is taking shape
First high-speed rail service will commence in 2027: Vaishnaw on bullet train

stories.title: NATO ally Latvia has a solution to Europe's drone testing headaches
Schools in Ukraine are to receive the F-Drones FPV simulator
stories.summary: The Ministry of Youth and Sport, the Ukrainian Technology Sports Federation, and F-Drones Simulator signed a memorandum granting schools access to drone simulation software for five years. In the 2026/2027 season, pupils in Years 5 to 9 will compete in the «Side by Side» project, with finalists using real FPV drones.

stories.title: Tesla Robotaxi: the fleet registered in Texas, tracked weekly
stories.summary: Tesla Robotaxi, LLC registered 1,507 autonomous vehicles with the Texas DMV as of November 19, 2026, including 773 Cybercab and 734 Model Y. The fleet increased by 768 vehicles since the first reading on October 9, 2026.

stories.title: Systematic Review Traces Drone Evolution from Military Reconnaissance to Biomimetic Wings
stories.summary: Researchers Amrutashree Hota and Gunabalan Madhumitha published a systematic review in the Journal of Intelligent and Robotic Systems tracing drone evolution from early twentieth-century military reconnaissance to modern miniaturized aerial platforms. The study analyzes how artificial intelligence, biomimetic design, and physical miniaturization transformed uncrewed flight into agile platforms for agriculture, logistics, and stealthy surveillance in constrained environments.

stories.title: Why the robots are ditching Uber
stories.summary: Waymo co-CEO Tekedra Mawakana announced the company will end its exclusive robotaxi partnership with Uber, allowing riders in Austin and Atlanta to use the Waymo app directly starting in January 2028. Serve Robotics also stated it will not renew its partnership with Uber Eats when it expires in 2027.

stories.title: Delhi-Lucknow Bullet Train To Cut Travel Time By 2 Hours, Corridor To Extend Up To Guwahati; Check Proposed Routes
stories.summary: Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced on October 31 that Prime Minister Narendra Modi approved the Northern Corridor of India’s proposed bullet train network. The route will link Delhi to Guwahati via Agra, Kanpur, Lucknow, Ayodhya, Varanasi, Patna, and Siliguri, reducing the Delhi-Lucknow journey to 2 hours and 12 minutes.

also.title: Delhi to Lucknow in 2 hours, UP's first bullet train to have 13 stations

stories.title: Overseas Revenue Up 171.5% YoY, Contributing Nearly Half of Total Revenue; Record High Quarterly Robotaxi Revenue of Over RMB100 Million; Third Quarter 2026 Revenue of RMB321.5 Million, Up 88.0% YoY; Gross Margin Reached 43.0%
stories.summary: WeRide Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of RMB321.5 million, up 88.0% year over year, with Robotaxi revenue exceeding RMB100 million for the first time. Overseas markets contributed nearly half of total revenue and more than 90% of Robotaxi revenue, while gross margin reached 43.0%.

also.title: WeRide Q3 Revenue Jumps 88% to RMB321.5 Million
WeRide revenue up 88% as overseas robotaxi business grows
WeRide's third-quarter revenue rises 88% as robotaxi revenue triples on overseas growth

stories.title: Kennedy Space Center Holiday Drone Show Jumps From 600 to 1,000 Drones
stories.summary: Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex will fly 1,000 drones over its Rocket Garden every night from December 20 to December 30, 2026, except Christmas Day. The show starts at 6:50 p.m. and is included with regular admission, which is $77 for adults and $67 for children aged 3 to 11.

stories.title: Ukrainian drones targeted oil terminal on Kola Peninsula
stories.summary: Ukrainian drones targeted the Vitino oil terminal in the Gulf of Kandalaksha on 11 November, according to Commander Robert "Madyar" Brovdi. NASA data indicates the drones failed to reach their target, as no fires were detected in the area.

stories.title: Elon Musk Keeps Pitching Tesla Self-Driving As Safer For Seniors. Some Residents Of The Villages Have Said They Use It On Nearly Every Trip
Your next delivery could fly: How close is Czechia to shopping by drone?
stories.summary: Property consultancy Colliers suggests that supermarket parking lots and retail parks could become launch sites for Czech delivery networks, utilizing existing stock and unused outdoor space. The analysis notes that individual drone deliveries remain comparatively expensive, but a denser network could improve economics by reducing flight distances between stores and households.

stories.title: Growth of the Autonomous Vehicle Market Driven by Technology Adoption and Industry Development
stories.summary: General Motors acquired full ownership of Cruise LLC in February 2025 to fast-track the development and commercialization of autonomous vehicle technology.

stories.title: US rail traffic rises 7.3% as intermodal gains 10.7% in latest week
stories.summary: The Association of American Railroads reported U.S. rail traffic rose 7.3% in the week ending November 14, 2026, as intermodal volume increased 10.7% and total carloads rose 3.3%. Motor vehicles and parts posted the strongest carload gain at 16.2%, while grain shipments fell 4.7%.

stories.title: US invites C-UAS industry to new threat coordination group meeting
stories.summary: The US Army intends to convene a Fires Threat Coordination Group to facilitate dialogue with cleared industry partners regarding emerging threats, including counter-unmanned aerial systems. Eligible companies with facility clearance are invited to attend a classified event in Charlottesville, Virginia in February 2027, with responses due by January 4 2027.

stories.title: FG Hails Kaduna–Kano Rail Progress, Confirms December Inauguration
stories.summary: The Federal Ministry of Transportation confirmed the Kaduna–Kano rail line is at an advanced stage, with the Kano terminal station substantially ready except for signage due in two weeks. Permanent Secretary Funso Adebiyi stated the ministry is seeking President Bola Tinubu's approval for a three-month test run from Jaji to Kano, potentially as a free passenger service, to assess structural integrity before commercial operations begin.

stories.title: Moroccan and U.S. soldiers test driverless vehicles designed to stop drones in Tan-Tan
stories.summary: Moroccan and U.S. soldiers tested driverless vehicles carrying counter-drone equipment in Tan-Tan from October 3 to 14, assessing performance on rough terrain and under electronic interference. The trials, part of the NANO ACE initiative, followed September tests in Yuma, Arizona, and involved more than 10 American defense companies.

also.title: US, Morocco Put Autonomous Counter-UAS Ground Vehicles to the Test at New Africa Training Center
Morocco & U.S. Armies Test Anti-Drone Robots to Deliver Faster New Technology to Warfighter

stories.title: Ukrainian forces strike Russian elite 'Rubicon' drone unit deployment site in Russian Kursk Oblast
stories.summary: Ukraine's 8th Air Assault Corps struck the deployment site of Russia's Rubicon-S drone unit in Rylsk, Kursk Oblast, on Nov. 20. The attack hit accommodation facilities and workshops, following a Nov. 7 strike on a Rubicon site in Berdiansk, Zaporizhzhia Oblast.

stories.title: Forsyth County Establishes US Public Safety Network of Automated Drone Docks
Vertical Aerospace Appoints Mudrick Capital Founder to Board
From the Averof to drones: The donations transforming the Hellenic Navy
stories.summary: Defence Minister Nikos Dendias requested a €250 million donation from the Union of Greek Shipowners to fund a fleet of Unmanned and Autonomous Maritime Systems. The initiative aims to strengthen the Hellenic Navy's capabilities in surveillance, reconnaissance, and mine-hunting, operating alongside new FDI frigates.

stories.title: Karnataka plans dedicated drone testing facility in Chikkaballapur to accelerate indigenous drone innovation
stories.summary: The Karnataka government is developing a dedicated Drone Testing Facility at Jeedarahalli village in Chikkaballapur district to provide flight testing and validation infrastructure for startups and drone companies. The facility, located near Bengaluru, will feature runways, hangars, and telemetry systems to accelerate commercialisation in sectors including agriculture, defence, and logistics.

stories.title: Russian drone enters Moldovan airspace during massive overnight attack on Ukraine
stories.summary: Moldova's Defense Ministry said a Russian drone violated Moldovan airspace for about nine minutes overnight during a massive Russian attack on Ukraine. The drone entered from the direction of Sadkivtsi in Ukraine’s Vinnytsia Oblast and left at 1:28 a.m. on Nov. 20.

also.title: Unauthorized drone crosses Moldovan airspace for nine minutes
Moldova detects new unauthorized drone breach in northern airspace

stories.title: India and Malaysia train on countering terrorist drones
stories.summary: Malaysian and Indian defence forces began Exercise HARIMAU SHAKTI in Ipoh, Malaysia, on 19 November to rehearse counter-terrorism operations and counter-unmanned aerial systems capabilities. Approximately 120 personnel from each country will conduct joint tactical drills in jungle and semi-urban terrain until 30 November, culminating in a simulated counter-terrorism scenario.

stories.title: FAA Advances AAM Integration With eIPP Demonstration Flights, Certification Steps, New Primer and Draft Vertiport Circular
stories.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration created the eVTOL and AAM Integration Pilot Program (eIPP) to accelerate deployment by seeking proposals from state, local, tribal and territorial governments partnered with private-sector organizations. The program aims to help the FAA develop regulatory frameworks and safety standards using data from demonstration flights.

stories.title: China eVTOL News Briefs: Suppliers' Roles in CE-25A and W5000 Test Flights, Boeing Executive on C919 Progress, C919 Safety Alliance Priorities
stories.summary: Suppliers detailed their roles in the test flights of the CE-25A and the W5000, while a Boeing executive described the progress of China's C919 airliner as "amazing." A C919 safety alliance also set its priorities for its next stage.

stories.title: Russian drone warhead weighing about 50 kg removed from residential building in Kyiv
stories.summary: Bomb disposal experts removed a 50 kg unexploded drone warhead from a residential building in Kyiv’s Podilskyi district. Law enforcement officials said the blast could have destroyed all five floors of the building.

stories.title: EASA Counts No Drone Deaths in 2025, but One Fell Into a Balloon
stories.summary: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) recorded no deaths from civil drones in 2025, counting 27 accidents and 12 serious incidents in its Annual Safety Review 2026. A 249-gram drone hit a hot-air balloon carrying eight people, resulting in one minor injury, while EASA ranked airborne collision as the top safety risk based on 3,667 drone reports with risk scores from 2023 through 2025.

stories.title: Unifly adds UTM and U-space support to EDF’s SPECTRE drone threat project
stories.summary: Unifly joined SPECTRE, a 24-month European Defence Fund project starting 1 November 2026, to provide UTM and U-space services that link civil drone traffic management with counter-unmanned aircraft systems. The consortium will validate the architecture in demonstrations in Belgium, Germany, and Estonia over the next two years.

also.title: Unifly Joins EU Defence Project SPECTRE on Counter-Drone Systems

stories.title: Nordic Air Defence Unveils K200 Drone Interceptor
stories.summary: Stockholm-based Nordic Air Defence unveiled the K200, an autonomous fixed-wing interceptor carrying a 500g warhead designed to counter drones at a fraction of the cost of conventional air defence missiles. The company opened an office in Ukraine to support testing of the system, which can be launched from the ground, vehicles, or maritime vessels.

also.title: Nordic Air Defense in Ukraine Tests High-Speed K200 Interceptor Drones, Opens Office
Sweden’s New ‘K200’ Drone Interceptor Will Cut Its Teeth in Ukraine

stories.title: How Ukraine used 11 weapons systems to strike Russia’s Kerch Bridge
stories.summary: Ukraine used 11 types of drones and missiles in a weeks-long operation against Russia’s Kerch Bridge, culminating in strikes that brought down a major section of the road crossing and damaged the parallel railway linking Russia with Crimea.

stories.title: FG Applauds Progress On Kaduna-Kano Rail Project, Reaffirms December Deadline For Commissioning
Egypt announces one-year rail safety plan following fatal collision
stories.summary: Egypt's Transport Minister Kamel Al-Wazir announced an urgent one-year plan to improve safety across the country's railway network following a fatal passenger train collision south of Cairo.

stories.title: Taiwan's drone industry looks to be booming. Inside, it's much shakier.
stories.summary: Taiwan aims to build a $1.5 billion drone industry by 2030, with drone export sales surging 34 times from 2024 to 2025. Local manufacturers and industry observers warn that weak supply chain management and lack of uniform standards threaten these ambitions.

stories.title: FCC expands connectivity for UAS operations in the United States
stories.summary: The FCC introduced rules opening the 450 MHz band for safety-related data links and permitting drones to use broadband connectivity from non-geostationary satellites in the 28.35-28.6 GHz band. The commission also allowed ground-based radar systems to use the 24.45–24.65 GHz band to detect and track unauthorised or dangerous UAS near airports, borders, prisons, stadiums, and critical infrastructure.

stories.title: GPU in Robotics and Smart Manufacturing Market to Reach USD 25.9 Billion by 2036 as AI-Powered Robotics and Sm
stories.summary: Fact.MR projects the global GPU in Robotics and Smart Manufacturing market will expand from USD 7.3 billion in 2026 to USD 25.9 billion by 2036, growing at a 13.5% CAGR. China leads country-level growth at a 14.7% CAGR, followed by the United States at 14.2% and Germany at 13.6%.

stories.title: Poland struck by 'drone or missile' near border with Ukraine
stories.summary: A drone or missile struck near Chmielek in Biłgoraj County, Poland, around 6:35am local time, violating NATO airspace. Polish authorities are investigating at least two unknown objects, and Prime Minister Donald Tusk has ordered a meeting with government ministers, security chiefs, and military officials to discuss the incident.

stories.title: Spanish Ministry of Industry backs VERTIMAS vertiport project at Teruel Airport
stories.summary: The 2026 call of the AEI programme has a budget of 9 million euros (around USD 10 million), according to the announcement made by minister Jordi Hereu in May. Teruel Airport will define the operational requirements and will study how these infrastructures can be integrated into an existing aerodrome.

stories.title: MARSS secures US$16m counter-drone contract in the Middle East
stories.summary: MARSS signed a US$16m contract to deploy counter-uncrewed aerial system protection at several sites of national strategic importance in the Middle East. Work begins immediately, with full deployment expected as soon as 2027.

also.title: MARSS secures USD 16 million counter drone contract in Middle East

stories.title: Petty theft case exposes North Korean worker at key Russian drone facility
Vector Unveils BOMBARD, a Pulse Jet One-Way Attack Drone
stories.summary: Vector announced BOMBARD, a ground-launched pulse jet strike drone, at the Axios Future of Defense Summit. The system flies up to 1,100 kilometers, cruises at 235 mph, weighs 281 pounds at takeoff, and carries a 110-pound payload.

also.title: Utah startup unveils long-range BOMBARD attack drone

stories.title: DUCO ROBOTS Expands Smart Manufacturing Presence in Thailand
stories.summary: DUCO ROBOTS officially inaugurated its Thailand subsidiary in Bangkok, marking a step in strengthening localized operations in Southeast Asia. The new office will provide technical support, product testing, and after-sales maintenance for local and neighboring markets.

stories.title: Elroy Air Lands UAE Cargo Drone Order before SPAC Vote
stories.summary: Abu Dhabi-based Barq Group ordered five Elroy Air Chaparral autonomous cargo drones and reserved 15 more under a $70 million agreement announced November 16. The deal precedes a November 25 shareholder vote on a merger that would take Elroy Air public on Nasdaq, with deliveries expected to begin in 2027.

stories.title: Airservices launches new drone traffic management system
stories.summary: Airservices Australia’s new drone traffic management system is now in operation, with the first drone flight completed. The system, developed with Frequentis Australasia and CASA since 2024, began live operations in late October to ensure unmanned aircraft navigate safely alongside passenger and cargo flights.

stories.title: Russian Missiles and a Jet-Powered Drone Entered Polish Airspace, Defence Ministry Says
stories.summary: Polish Defence Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz said Russian missiles and a jet-powered drone violated Polish airspace, with debris found near Mołodycz, Rudnik nad Sanem, and Nowy Lipowiec. Swedish Gripen pilots attempted to intercept a probable Kh-101 missile but did not use weapons, while the objects remained in Polish airspace for up to three minutes.

also.title: Poland Condemns Russian 'Provocation' After 3 Airspace Violations
Poland Reopens Two Airports After Russian Missiles and Drone Enter Airspace

stories.title: Black Sea Drone Attacks: Romania and Turkey Intensify Security Efforts as Bulgaria Holds Back
stories.summary: Romania and Turkey held seven national security council meetings over six months to address the Russia-Ukraine war, airspace violations, threats to commercial shipping, and the risk of the conflict spreading across the Black Sea region. The latest Romanian session on October 22 focused on protecting commercial vessels and maritime infrastructure.

also.title: ​Bulgaria Deploys Its Su-25 Jets to Patrol the Black Sea Amid Drone Threat

stories.title: Russian attack damages railway infrastructure and causes train delays
stories.summary: Ukrzaliznytsia resumed Kyiv's circular commuter train service despite Russian missile and drone attacks that damaged railway infrastructure and caused delays. The state-run operator stated it is strictly observing safety measures and evacuating passengers when threats arise, while staff work to repair the damaged sections.

stories.title: Indian Army Selects SSS Defence as Lowest Bidder for 84 Indigenous T-12 Anti-Drone Shotguns
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based SSS Defence emerged as the lowest bidder for 84 indigenous T-12 semi-automatic shotguns in an Indian Army procurement process. The 12-gauge weapons, designed to counter low-flying drones at ranges of 50 to 100 metres, are linked to Army requirements at Gwalior.

also.title: SSS Defence Named L-1 Bidder for Indian Army’s 84 Indigenous T-12 Counter-Drone Shotguns

stories.title: From Dronathon to Doctrine: The Counter-Drone Battle Has Become a Force-Structure Question
stories.summary: The Indian Air Force held its first Dronathon at Pokhran from September 14 to 16, 2026, with more than 20 defense companies participating to examine counter-unmanned technologies. The IAF released its Unmanned Aircraft Systems Roadmap during the event and conducted further industry outreach on October 21, 2026.

stories.title: AUVSI: Drone and AAM Operations Have Scaled, but Part 108 Standards, Security Framework and Public Acceptance Remain the Hurdles
stories.summary: AUVSI listed standards that shape the rules, public acceptance as infrastructure, a workable security framework, and a talent pipeline as four priorities for the year ahead. The organization will keep advocating for timely finalization of Part 108 and will convene stakeholders at the Drone & AAM Policy Symposium and XPONENTIAL 2027 in Miami Beach, May 17–20.

stories.title: State Grid Changzhou Power Supply Company Successfully Develops and Trials an Overhead Line Insulating Sleeve Installation Robot
stories.summary: State Grid Changzhou Power Supply Company completed a pilot operation in Jintan, Changzhou, for an overhead line insulating sleeve installation robot that weighs less than 30 kg. The device, adapted for networks of 35 kV and below, lays 30 meters of sleeves in 15 minutes while ground personnel remotely control it.

stories.title: Walmart proposes drone delivery hub at Arvada store, drawing neighborhood concerns
stories.summary: Walmart and drone operator Wing proposed a grocery delivery hub at the 9400 Ralston Rd. store, serving customers within approximately six miles. A Dec. 3 meeting will allow residents to question the companies before a potential formal permit application.

stories.title: Collaborative Robotic Welding System Cuts Structural Frame Lead Times by 53
stories.summary: Researchers published a study in the Journal of Intelligent & Robotic Systems showing a collaborative robotic welding system reduced structural frame lead times by up to 53 percent. The automated setup used a 400 A metal active gas welding source on a collaborative robot to handle high-mix, low-volume production for luxury retail fit-out projects.

stories.title: [Series3] Humanoid Data War: Real Factories Now Train Robot AI
stories.summary: China operates 70 robot training sites nationwide, including a 10,000-square-meter facility in Beijing's Shijingshan District where 100 humanoids generate four hours of data daily. The construction of these large-scale training environments is officially included in the outline of China's 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-2030).

stories.title: Forum: Safety is the top priority in autonomous vehicle trials
stories.summary: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) stated that all autonomous vehicles in on-road trials must comply with traffic rules and LTA safety requirements, with trained safety operators on board for every journey. LTA will publish quarterly reports on deployment scale, passenger experience, and safety performance starting next month.

stories.title: Russian Air Defenses Down 310 Ukrainian Drones Overnight
stories.summary: Russian air defenses destroyed 310 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones overnight on November 20, targeting multiple regions and the waters of two seas. The attacks killed three people in the Saratov region and injured 13 in Kursk, where 98 buildings and 67 vehicles were damaged.

stories.title: Railway supply industry news round-up
stories.summary: The London Court of International Arbitration ordered Ethiopian Railways Corp to pay Turkish contractor Yapı Merkezi US$307.6m, concluding a dispute over construction works for the Awash – Kombolcha – Hara Gebeya railway which were suspended because of the war in Tigray.

stories.title: Ukrainian Drone Boat Sinks Second Russian Sea Drone
stories.summary: Ukraine’s Sargan 3000 unmanned surface vessel destroyed a Russian uncrewed boat during a Nov. 16 nighttime engagement, marking the platform’s second reported victory in a naval drone duel. The Ukrainian Navy released footage of the attack but did not disclose the location or confirm whether the Russian vessel sank.

stories.title: U.S. Expeditionary Wing Sharpens Counter-Drone Skills in UAS Training
Robotics enters its post-Jensen Huang era
stories.summary: NVIDIA's board accepted Jensen Huang's resignation on Nov. 12, and CFO Colette Kress is serving as interim CEO while the company searches for a permanent successor. NVIDIA said during its third-quarter earnings call that its physical AI revenue nearly tripled year over year and is on track to exceed $25 billion in fiscal 2027.

stories.title: South Korean Firm Weighs $150 Million Investment in Eric Trump-Backed Military Robot Maker
stories.summary: South Korean conglomerate Base Group is considering a $150 million investment in Foundation Future Industries, a U.S. robotics startup developing humanoid machines for industrial and military applications. The proposed partnership would also involve establishing a joint venture to supply aluminum for robot manufacturing and lithium for batteries.

stories.title: Europeans have created a powerful vehicle for launching dozens of drones—it can use Ukrainian weapons
stories.summary: European company GDELS and Germany's Auterion unveiled the Eagle V 6x6, a combat vehicle equipped with Nemyx VLS vertical launchers for 32 interceptors or 64 strike and reconnaissance drones. The platform is potentially compatible with Ukrainian SkyFall unmanned aerial vehicles, though compatibility with the launchers still needs to be confirmed.

stories.title: Risk-Informed Framework Resolves Autonomous Vehicle Decisions in Mixed
Moldova Plans Domestic Drone Manufacturing Amid Rising Security Concerns, Law to Be Enacted by 2027
stories.summary: Moldova's Prime Minister Vasile Tofan urged swift approval of a defense industry bill to establish domestic drone manufacturing, citing over 110 unauthorized drone flights since Russia's invasion of Ukraine. The legislation is expected to take effect by January 1, 2027.

stories.title: Pony AI Hits 2,768 Robotaxis, Outpacing Tesla
stories.summary: Pony AI reported third-quarter revenue of US$44.6 million and a net loss of US$105.6 million on November 18, 2026. The company stated its robotaxi fleet reached 2,768 vehicles as of September 30, with a full-year target of 3,500.

stories.title: Momenta and Uber Launch Robotaxi Pilot in Germany, Offering Free Rides to Passengers
stories.summary: Momenta and Uber launched a Robotaxi pilot in Munich, Germany, on November 18, offering free rides to passengers who request UberX, Electric, or Comfort services in northern Munich. The program allows Momenta to conduct Level 4 autonomous driving tests on urban roads across Germany without needing separate permits for each city.

also.title: Uber robotaxi trial in Munich is free and supervised

stories.title: Ex-British Army pilot says HE caused the drone alert at RAF Lakenheath
stories.summary: Former British Army pilot Sam Rutherford says his formation of three Cirrus SR20 light aircraft caused the drone alert at RAF Lakenheath last Friday. The planes were flying over Norfolk and Suffolk to Belgium when the base went into lockdown and sirens sounded.

also.title: Cirrus aircraft mistaken for drones near RAF Lakenheath and in Moldova

stories.title: Tesla's Cybercab raises concerns among automakers and battery suppliers
stories.summary: Tesla began taking preorders for its $29,990 two-seat Cybercab robotaxi from select U.S. consumers on the 13th, with deliveries scheduled to begin next month. The vehicle, which entered mass production this year, is expected to take a substantial share of demand for other vehicles and reduce demand for purchased battery cells as Tesla plans to produce its own battery cells.

also.title: Tesla's Cybercab Can Be Privately Owned but Not Manually Driven, Resold Freely, or Used Without the Monthly Subscription

stories.title: Russia's Geran-6 Drones Could Target Kiev Bridges: Expert
stories.summary: Military analyst Yuri Knutov warned that Russia's new Geran-6 jet drones could target Kiev bridges, while Ukrainian lawmaker Fyodor Venislavsky reported the UAVs reach speeds of up to 1,000 kilometers per hour, potentially challenging Ukrainian air defenses.

stories.title: Lee & Ko to co-host seminar on human-robot coexistence
stories.summary: Lee & Ko and the Korean Society for Internet Ethics will co-host a seminar on human-robot coexistence at 2 p.m. on the 27th at the Hanjin Building in Seoul's Jung District. The event will examine robotics industry development, safety standards, legal liability, and employment transitions through three simultaneous sessions.

stories.title: British Army needs to train almost half of all infantry to use drones, experts warn
stories.summary: The Royal United Services Institute (Rusi) report states that almost half of all the infantry in the British army should be retrained as drone operators. The report says that if Ukrainian levels of UAV use were adopted, approximately 45% of a British Light Infantry Battalion would make up the UAV enterprise.

also.title: More drones bring huge manpower costs for infantry units, report finds

stories.title: UN Killer Robot Talks End With No Binding LAWS Treaty Mandate
stories.summary: The UN Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons (CCW) Review Conference ended on November 20, 2026 without launching legally binding negotiations on lethal autonomous weapons (LAWS). Euronews reported diplomats remained deadlocked after Russia repeatedly demanded changes to the draft final report.

stories.title: MIIT Unveils 5 Humanoid Robot Industry Standards | Intelligent Capability Classification & Training Site Construction Standards Explained
stories.summary: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology issued five humanoid robot standards on November 16, 2026, covering intelligent capability classification, training site construction, and key components. The new rules establish six capability levels from L0 to L5 and define technical requirements for training sites, integrated electric drive joints, dexterous hands, and training data management.

stories.title: Estonian builder launches semi-autonomous naval vessel demonstrator
stories.summary: Estonia’s Baltic Workboats launched the Euroguard experimental naval vessel at its Nasva shipyard on November 19. The 45-metre semi-autonomous prototype is designed for military missions and testing research systems in actual sea conditions, with a speed of at least 20 knots and a range of around 2,000 nautical miles.

also.title: EU deploys semi-autonomous vessel in Estonia to protect undersea cables

stories.title: Taiwan robot suppliers target 2027 validation, 2028 volume production
stories.summary: Taiwan robot suppliers target 2027 validation and 2028 volume production as Tesla's Optimus enters early production at a California factory.

stories.title: Wisk Opens Hollister Vertiport, NASA Unveils X-70 Fractal, Eve and FlyBIS Sign Up-to-12 eVTOL Deal
stories.summary: Wisk Aero completed and launched its new vertiport at Hollister Municipal Airport in California, described as one of the nation's first public, on-airport vertiports supporting both piloted and autonomous operations. The 100-foot by 100-foot site serves as a dedicated testbed for terminal area procedures, precision landing evaluation, and approach and departure profile validation.

stories.title: AutoFlight Completes Five-eVTOL Formation Flight Across Three Aircraft Models in Kunshan, China
stories.summary: AutoFlight completed a five-eVTOL formation flight across three aircraft models at its Bailian Lake Flight Test Base in Kunshan, China, on October 31 and November 1. The autonomous 47-minute flight involved one 5-ton V5000 Matrix and four 2-ton eVTOLs, with the lead aircraft covering more than 133 km.

stories.title: AIFA Traffic, US Air Outages, Drone Rules: The Week in Aerospace
stories.summary: Felipe Ángeles International Airport projected a 7% passenger increase to 7.6 million travelers in 2026, while a US air traffic control outage disrupted 70 flights at Mexico City International Airport. Commercial drone operators are evaluating forming a Civil Association to modernize airspace regulations, and federal authorities are evaluating four redesigned departure routes at Mexico City International Airport for implementation in March or April 2027.

stories.title: FAA Lists Three Drone-Only TFRs in Utah and California, Anchorage VIP TFR Thursday, White Sands Closures Through Friday
stories.summary: The FAA posted three drone-only security TFRs in Utah and California, a VIP TFR over Anchorage on Thursday, and missile-test closures at White Sands, New Mexico, on Thursday and Friday. A New York City VIP TFR posted for Wednesday afternoon was removed from the live list before its window.

stories.title: 3 armed Philadelphia carjacking suspects arrested in Bensalem with help from drone
stories.summary: Bensalem Township police arrested three armed carjacking suspects in Bensalem after a police drone and license plate readers helped locate them following a Tuesday afternoon theft in Philadelphia. Authorities recovered a loaded .40-caliber handgun and reported no injuries during the apprehension.

stories.title: War Department Advances Unmanned Fleet Coordination
stories.summary: The Department of War advanced its Autonomous Vehicle Orchestrator software program, which enables a single operator to direct a mixed fleet of unmanned vehicles across multiple domains. Launched Jan. 13, 2026, the AVO Challenge focused on developing market-ready software to coordinate disparate unmanned systems into a coordinated team.

stories.title: Driverless Trucks Begin Testing on Ohio Roads
stories.summary: Companies began testing autonomous trucks on Ohio roads, with Enride stating it scales the technology only when data supports it. Some groups, including the Owner-operator Independent Drivers Association, called for more oversight before wider deployment.

stories.title: Unions Launch Campaign Against Driverless Ride Pilot
stories.summary: 32BJ SEIU and the App Drivers Union launched a campaign urging New Jersey lawmakers to reject bills S1677 and A3968, which would allow fully autonomous rideshare networks to operate after 100,000 test miles. The unions argue the bills threaten rideshare employment and are targeting the State League of Municipalities conference in Atlantic City.

also.title: New Jersey Rideshare Drivers Launch Campaign Urging Rejection Driverless Vehicle Pilot

stories.title: 'One of the Best Tools We Have:' How law enforcement across Northern Kentucky relies on drone technology
stories.summary: Police in Independence, Kentucky, used drone technology and infrared imaging to locate a strangulation suspect in an attic on Monday. The Campbell County Police Department reported completing hundreds of missions, while Kenton County officers have utilized the technology since 2017.

stories.title: Regent Squire Wing-In-Ground Effect Drone To Patrol Middle East Waters
stories.summary: Regent reached a deal to sell an unspecified number of autonomous Squire Seagliders to a U.S. government customer, CEO Billy Thalheimer announced. The electric-powered drones will form a small fleet deployed in the Middle East next year for multi-domain perception, operating autonomously at up to 70 knots with a range of more than 100 nautical miles.

stories.title: A Driverless Waymo Stopped on San Diego’s Trolley Tracks, Then Reversed Through the Crossing Gate and Broke Its Own Back Window
stories.summary: A Waymo driverless car stopped on trolley tracks at the County Center/Little Italy station in San Diego on Nov. 16, then reversed through the crossing gates and broke its own back window. The San Diego Metropolitan Transit System confirmed the crash, is investigating, and is in contact with Waymo and the California Department of Motor Vehicles.

stories.title: Tesla Plans a Model Y With No Steering Wheel or Pedals for Families
stories.summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk announced plans for a driverless Model Y without a steering wheel or pedals to carry six or seven people, complementing the two-seat Cybercab. Tesla has not provided a production timeline, price, or intended markets for the vehicle.

stories.title: Tesla Robotaxis Drove 705,000 km in One Week in Austin, More Than Waymo: Report
stories.summary: Physical AI Data reported that Tesla's Austin Robotaxi fleet covered an estimated 705,000 km in the week ending October 18, surpassing Waymo's April-to-June weekly average of about 653,000 km in the city.

stories.title: Baton Rouge Police Adds Axon Dedrone Counter-Drone Airspace System
stories.summary: Baton Rouge Police is adding Axon's Dedrone counter-drone technology for real-time airspace security, alongside upgraded body cameras, in-car cameras, TASER devices, and Axon Virtual Reality for officer training.

stories.title: US Air Force announces new focus on sensors and autonomous warfare — with drone-killing kit top of the list
stories.summary: The US Air Force introduced Force Design 2026, a modernization plan prioritizing advanced sensors, artificial intelligence, and autonomous systems to counter aerial threats. The strategy succeeds the One Force Design framework from October 2024 and emphasizes integrating detection technologies with existing aircraft to coordinate operations when conventional communications fail.

stories.title: Flying drone taxis set to hit Phuket next year
Canada Opens Ottawa Counter-Drone Sandbox With $1.75M in Prizes
stories.summary: Canada’s Department of National Defence is seeking counter-drone systems to detect, track, and identify micro and mini drones in urban environments. Chosen entrants will demonstrate in downtown Ottawa from July 26 to 30, 2027, competing for $1.75 million in prizes, with proposals closing December 1, 2026.

stories.title: XPeng Sets AI Day for November 25 With IRON Robot and Robotaxi
stories.summary: XPeng will hold its eighth AI Day in Guangzhou on November 25, showcasing its IRON humanoid robot and offering rides on driver assistance from NGP up to a Level 4 robotaxi.

stories.title: Pentagon Seeks New Command to Oversee Autonomous Warfare
stories.summary: The Trump administration's Defense Department is seeking congressional authorization to establish a four-star Autonomous Warfare Command by Oct. 1, 2027, according to a new Congressional Research Service (CRS) report. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth issued a memorandum Sept. 30 directing the Direct Reporting Portfolio Manager for Unmanned Systems to lead Project Agincourt, an initiative intended to establish the new command.

stories.title: MassRobotics Opens Marine Robotics Facility in Boston
stories.summary: MassRobotics opened a marine robotics facility at Boston's Fish Pier, part of Massport's Blue Edge initiative, to provide startups with a practical place to test ocean technology without renting boat time or traveling to remote locations. The site includes a water tank, a float for direct water testing, and lifting equipment, allowing companies to design prototypes in the MassRobotics machine shop and walk them to the pier for same-day harbor testing.

stories.title: Kyiv’s partners should prioritize Ukraine’s domestic drone production
stories.summary: Ukrainian long-range drone strikes reduced Russian oil refining output by around 45 percent since late October, causing renewed fuel shortages and challenging energy exports that fund the Kremlin war machine. The article argues Kyiv’s partners should prioritize Ukraine’s domestic drone production to address the gap between the country’s $30 billion defense procurement plan and its potential $60 billion domestic output.

stories.title: KNDS Shows AI Counter-Drone FENNEK AIR Prototype at NEDS
stories.summary: KNDS Deutschland displayed a prototype of the FENNEK AIR counter-drone vehicle at the NIDV Exhibition Defence and Security in Rotterdam on November 18. The system pairs the FENNEK platform with AI decision support and a 30 mm cannon to engage drones.

stories.title: Grapevine Police to establish $1M Drone First Responder Program
stories.summary: The Grapevine Police Department is creating a $1 million Drone First Responder Program with three Skydio X10 drones to respond to calls, provide live video, and assist in investigations. The city council unanimously approved the purchase on Nov. 17, and the department will pay $209,713 annually for five years to own the drones.

stories.title: Deadly Lockland fire sparks new push from Congressman to address blocked railroad crossings
Hackers try to plant malware into Ukraine-bound drones — Germany's Quantum Systems says there's 'no risk' after cyberattack failed
stories.summary: German drone manufacturer Quantum Systems confirmed that unidentified hackers attempted to introduce malicious software into its update distribution system in late October. The company stated the malware did not reach the aircraft themselves, though it circulated through infrastructure belonging to several customers, prompting the Bundeswehr to temporarily suspend operations involving its entire Quantum Systems drone fleet.

stories.title: NRC: Destinus Staff Helped Launch Drones Toward Voronezh
stories.summary: NRC reports that Destinus staff tested explosive drones near Kharkov in 2023 and helped launch them toward Voronezh, where a drone strike injured three people. Destinus denied taking part in military operations, maintaining its activities were limited to providing technical support.

stories.title: MBARI Robot Fleet Tracks Marine Life in California Offshore Wind Zones
EBRD: Morocco expands automotive exports as drone industry gains ground
stories.summary: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development reported that Morocco’s automotive exports now account for approximately 13% of total exports, making it Africa’s largest car exporter. The bank noted that drone-related component exports increased 1.6 times in 2024 compared with the 2019–2021 average, while a partnership between Casava Technologies and Nvidia aims to develop AI factories in Morocco.

stories.title: HENSOLDT Hands Spexer Drone-Defence Radar Production to ZF
stories.summary: HENSOLDT and ZF Friedrichshafen signed a cooperation agreement on November 18 for ZF to establish scalable series production of Spexer radars and build an automated test system. ZF will manufacture and deliver the radars directly to customers, while HENSOLDT retains all intellectual property rights.

stories.title: Tesla’s Cybercab Crashed at 53 MPH on a Philadelphia Highway With a Test Driver Aboard — Then Tesla Redacted What Happened
stories.summary: Tesla filed a crash report with the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration detailing a September collision involving a Cybercab traveling at 53 mph in Philadelphia, but redacted the narrative field as confidential business information. The report lists a test driver aboard, notes the other vehicle's airbag deployed, and leaves injury status unknown.

stories.title: UCLA Police Given OK for Ammunition, Drone Purchases
stories.summary: The University of California Board of Regents approved UCLA Police Department purchases of 50 40mm foam-tipped projectile rounds, 1,950 pepperball rounds, and six drones. The report stated the equipment is necessary for campus expansion and the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games, where the campus will house up to 17,000 athletes.

stories.title: China tightens export controls on components for Russian drones
stories.summary: China's Commerce Ministry tightened export controls on drone components, including jet-turbine engines for Russia's Geran series, effective Nov. 18. Exporters must now seek licenses to ship jet and electric drone engines, radio transmitters, and speed controllers.

stories.title: Inside Symbotic’s automated warehouse: robotics, software and Rockwell integration
stories.summary: C&S Wholesale Grocers operates an eight-level automated warehouse in Connecticut using Symbotic's technology, which includes 155 robots and Rockwell Automation's control and networking systems. The facility processes up to 1,350 cases per hour during outbound operations.

stories.title: Reach Power Signs Army CRADA to Beam Power to Small Drones
stories.summary: Reach Power signed a Cooperative Research and Development Agreement with the U.S. Army’s DEVCOM Ground Vehicle Systems Center to test vehicle-mounted wireless power for small uncrewed aircraft. The work will pair Reach’s beamforming hardware with a Valinor Dispatch drone dock and a Red Cat Black Widow reconnaissance drone.

stories.title: $2.83M Grant to Help Calif. Police Department Expand Drone Program, Intelligence Center
Arbe Robotics (NASDAQ:ARBE) Q3 Earnings: Level 3 Radar Win and Counter-Drone Launch Accompany USD 9.0M Net Loss
stories.summary: Arbe Robotics reported a third-quarter 2026 net loss of USD 9.0 million and revenue of USD 0.8 million, while announcing that HiRain’s imaging radar, built on its chipset, was selected for a Level 3 passenger vehicle program in China. The company also launched Alerion, a counter-drone radar, and stated that series-production radar deliveries are planned to start in the fourth quarter of 2027.

stories.title: California High-Speed Rail Authority recovers $1.34M from consultants
stories.summary: California High-Speed Rail Authority recovered $1.34 million in travel payments from four consultants, exceeding the $592,900 its inspector general found unallowable. The authority plans to issue a request for qualifications in December 2026 and consider a proposed award in May 2027.

stories.title: J-Star Taps Mitsubishi Chemical for US Drone Airframe Plant
stories.summary: J-Star Holding named Mitsubishi Chemical a primary supplier of specialty carbon fiber for its planned U.S. drone airframe plant near Houston. The companies set material supply strategies for 2027 and 2028, aiming to source 100% of specialty materials through U.S. channels.

stories.title: Midland and New Mexico Spaceports Team Up on 250-Nautical-Mile Supersonic Test Corridor
stories.summary: Midland Development Corporation, Midland International Air & Space Port, the New Mexico Spaceport Authority, and Starfighters Space signed a letter of intent to create a 250-nautical-mile supersonic test corridor linking Midland to Spaceport America. The agreement precedes a joint memorandum of understanding and does not establish final federal authorization or an operating timeline.

stories.title: Bullet Train: Surat-Bilimora Section to Get Power on Nov 20
stories.summary: The National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited will energise the 50-km Surat-Bilimora section of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad corridor on November 20. This first section to receive power uses a 2 × 25 kV overhead traction system, with the Ministry of Railways warning that the wires will remain live.

stories.title: EOS Names Kais Mnif President of Counter-Drone Firm MARSS
stories.summary: Electro Optic Systems appointed Kaïs Mnif as President and Chairman of MARSS Group, the counter-drone specialist it acquired in May 2026. Mnif will be based in Nice and report to EOS chief executive Andreas Schwer, while Johannes Pinl remains MARSS chief executive leading sales and growth.

stories.summary: Metropolis Robotics presented its SKYE humanoid robot at the IMEC NextGen Manufacturing AI Summit in Downers Grove, Ill., on November 12, 2026. The Gurnee-based company demonstrated a phased path to task-ready robots for Illinois manufacturers.

stories.title: Türkiye becomes 1st to add unmanned fighter jet to military inventory
stories.summary: Baykar announced Thursday that Türkiye became the first country to add an unmanned fighter jet to its military inventory after delivering three Kızılelma combat aircraft to security forces. The jets completed 600 test and training sorties before entering active service, and Baykar signed a contract with Indonesia this May for 12 Kızılelma aircraft starting in 2028.

Ecuadorian fishermen sue US government over 'war crime' drone strike at sea
stories.summary: Ecuadorian fishermen sued the Trump administration on Monday, seeking at least $US5 million in damages for alleged war crimes during a Galapagos Islands fishing trip. The 16 men claim US forces attacked their vessel with drones on March 17, tortured them, and held them as prisoners in El Salvador.

stories.title: Nomadic Raises $6 Million for Drones That Land on and Charge From Power Lines
stories.summary: Munich-based Nomadic raised $6 million in seed funding to expand its drone system that lands on live high-voltage lines to recharge and monitor grid conditions. The company plans to use the capital to grow its fleet and add utility customers in Europe and the United States, with remote drone relocation expected in production by 2027.

stories.title: From Farm Fields to Oyster Beds: Agricultural Drones Find a New Use
stories.summary: Jeri’s Seafood released more than one million baby oysters into Galveston Bay using an XAG agricultural drone. An FAA spokesman said oyster bed seeding is not considered agriculture, so the operator would need a Part 91 exemption and would have to follow all safety and airspace rules.

stories.title: Boston Dynamics launches next-generation Stretch robot with major reliability upgrades
stories.summary: Boston Dynamics unveiled Stretch Gen 2, an autonomous mobile trailer unloading robot featuring heavy-duty automotive-grade connectors and a modular design that reduces a full swerve drive swap from a full day to about one hour. The robot unloads up to 1000 cases per hour and reaches 90 percent charge in about 75 minutes.

stories.title: Ukraine says drones hit over 2 million Russian targets in 2026, with October tally nearly 2.5 times January’s
stories.summary: Ukraine’s Ministry of Defence said its forces have hit more than 2 million Russian targets with drones since the start of 2026, including more than 320,000 Russian military personnel killed or seriously wounded. October recorded approximately 257,264 hits, almost 2.5 times the figure for January.

stories.title: Drone Operators Face Prosecution After Ignoring Airspace Restrictions in Leicester
stories.summary: Leicestershire Police prosecuted ten drone operators who ignored temporary airspace restrictions during Leicester’s Diwali celebrations. Officers used specialist technology to track the drones, identify the pilots, and seize all 10 aircraft.
